title: working on a game, my chat keep getting flagged since a few days
author: daffyss
selftext:
I can't work on any part of my project! I tried model switch, rephrasing ect nothing works!

I keep getting those messages "Fable 5.1's safeguards.... This sometimes happens with safe, normal conversations. Claude Code can't respond to this message with Fable 5.1."

Anyone familiar with this?  
I wrote to Anthropic support but I never head back from them.

comments.author: TrashPocketz
comments.body: Well, what kind of game and what type of content are you creating?

replies.author: daffyss
replies.body:
A game about space ships and space combat, so lots of words like missiles and lazers.  
But, it's a game, like i can't understand how with all the code and context the model has access to it still flags my chats :(

replies.author: TrashPocketz
replies.body: Hmm. I dunno. I just made a small prototype with machine gun turrets last night and Claude had no issue.

replies.author: daffyss
replies.body:
well. i'm happy for you i guess?   
it's to the point now, where reading through code it already wrote days ago, it get's flagged...by it's own code...ridiculous.

comments.author: Patera-Milenko
comments.body: Have Claude check your work for potential issues that might have caused the flagging issue?

replies.author: daffyss
replies.body:
no i did not. I asked it general questions like what might cause the problem.   
would that mean that if I don't call my in game missile "missile" but something random like Cotton candys it would not trigger?

comments.author: zloy_molo4nik
comments.body: Do not make a porn games with AI :)

comments.author: GT86
comments.body: I had a subagent fail a few times on me. Orchestrator didn't know why. But I realised it was because it was expanding the lockon missile logic in my space dogfighting Sim. Which I found quite funny, probably flagged on a list now. Orchestrator agreed and made sure to specify that it's work was for a game, not weapons manufacturing lol.

replies.author: daffyss
replies.body:
Damn, that sounds like my issue! one of my chat was also working on lockons. Can you tell me how you got arround the issue? 

i tried to add a sort of disclamer before my imputs but it did not work, even when i ask it to read the game design doc!

replies.author: GT86
replies.body: Huh. Weird. I joked with the orchestrator (opus 5.5 high) that it probably thought we were developing munitions. It agreed and then ensured that when it sent it's instructions through the third time it specified it was for a game.

comments.author: frigginwizard420
comments.body: I'm not sure, but also, use opus
